name: What types of lighting fixtures are best for a hallway?

mainEntity.name: What types of lighting fixtures are best for a hallway?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hallways benefit from various lighting types depending on length, ceiling height, and desired ambiance. Recessed lighting offers a clean, unobtrusive look, providing general illumination. Flush mount or semi-flush mount fixtures are suitable for lower ceilings. For longer hallways, consider track lighting or multiple ceiling fixtures spaced evenly to avoid dark spots. Wall sconces can add decorative accents and ambient light, especially when paired with ceiling fixtures. Dimmers are highly recommended to adjust brightness for different times of day or moods.
acceptedAnswer.description: Recessed lights, flush mounts, track lighting, and wall sconces are popular choices for hallways. The best type depends on ceiling height, hallway length, and desired aesthetic.
